1.english_reference: The word of the LORD came again unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et factum est verbum Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: The word of the LORD came again unto me , saying ,

2.english_reference: Now , thou son of man , take up a lamentation for Tyrus ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֔ם שָׂ֥א עַל צֹ֖ר קִינָֽה
traditions.LXX: Υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου , καὶ σὺ λάβε ἐπὶ Σὸρ θρῆνον ,
traditions.VUL: Tu ergo fili hóminis , assúme super Tyrum laméntum :
traditions.KJV: Now , thou son of man , take up a lamentation for Tyrus ;

3.english_reference: And say unto Tyrus , O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַרְתָּ֣ לְ צ֗וֹר ה ישבתי עַל מְבוֹאֹ֣ת יָ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρεῖς τῇ Σὸρ τῇ κατοικούσῃ ἐπὶ τῆς εἰσόδου τῆς θαλάσσης ,
traditions.VUL: et dices Tyro , quæ hábitat in intróitu maris ,
traditions.KJV: And say unto Tyrus , O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea , [ which art ]

3.english_reference: [ which art ] a merchant of the people for many isles ,

traditions.WLC: רֹכֶ֨לֶת֙ הָֽ עַמִּ֔ים אֶל אִיִּ֖ים רַבִּ֑ים
traditions.LXX: τῷ ἐμπορίῳ τῶν λαῶν ἀπὸ νήσων πολλῶν
traditions.VUL: negotiatióni populórum ad ínsulas multas :
traditions.KJV: a merchant of the people for many isles ,

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the Lord GOD ;

3.english_reference: O Tyrus , thou hast said , I [ am ] of perfect beauty .

traditions.WLC: צ֕וֹר אַ֣תְּ אָמַ֔רְתְּ אֲנִ֖י כְּלִ֥ילַת יֹֽפִי
traditions.LXX: τῇ Σόρ Σὺ εἶπας Ἐγὼ περιέθηκα ἐμαυτῇ κάλλος μου ,
traditions.VUL: O Tyre , tu dixísti : Perfécti decóris ego sum ,
traditions.KJV: O Tyrus , thou hast said , I [ am ] of perfect beauty .

4.english_reference: Thy borders [ are ] in the midst of the seas ,

traditions.WLC: בְּ לֵ֥ב יַמִּ֖ים גְּבוּלָ֑יִ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐν καρδίᾳ θαλάσσης τῷ Βεελεὶμ
traditions.VUL: et in corde maris sita .
traditions.KJV: Thy borders [ are ] in the midst of the seas ,

4.english_reference: thy builders have perfected thy beauty .

traditions.WLC: בֹּנַ֕יִ ךְ כָּלְל֖וּ יָפְיֵֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: υἱοί σου περιέθηκάν σοι κάλλος .
traditions.VUL: Finítimi tui , qui te ædificavérunt , implevérunt decórem tuum :
traditions.KJV: thy builders have perfected thy beauty .

5.english_reference: They have made all thy [ ship ] boards of fir trees of Senir :

traditions.WLC: בְּרוֹשִׁ֤ים מִ שְּׂנִיר֙ בָּ֣נוּ לָ֔ ךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל לֻֽחֹתָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: κέδρος ἐκ Σενεὶρ ᾠκοδομήθη σοι , ταινίαι σανίδων κυπαρίσσου
traditions.VUL: abiétibus de Sanir exstruxérunt te cum ómnibus tabulátis maris :
traditions.KJV: They have made all thy [ ship ] boards of fir trees of Senir :

5.english_reference: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee .

traditions.WLC: אֶ֤רֶז מִ לְּבָנוֹן֙ לָקָ֔חוּ לַ עֲשׂ֥וֹת תֹּ֖רֶן עָלָֽיִ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐκ τοῦ Λιβάνου ἐλήμφθησαν τοῦ ποιῆσαί σοι ἱστοὺς ἐλατίνους ·
traditions.VUL: cedrum de Líbano tulérunt ut fácerent tibi malum .
traditions.KJV: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee .

6.english_reference: [ Of ] the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars ;

traditions.WLC: אַלּוֹנִים֙ מִ בָּ֔שָׁן עָשׂ֖וּ מִשּׁוֹטָ֑יִ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐκ τῆς Βασανίτιδος ἐποίησαν τὰς κώπας σου ,
traditions.VUL: Quercus de Basan dolavérunt in remos tuos ,
traditions.KJV: [ Of ] the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars ;

6.english_reference: the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches [ of ] ivory ,

traditions.WLC: קַרְשֵׁ֤ ךְ עָֽשׂוּ שֵׁן֙ בַּת אֲשֻׁרִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: τὰ ἱερά σου ἐποίησαν ἐξ ἐλέφαντος ,
traditions.VUL: et transtra tua fecérunt tibi ex ébore índico ,
traditions.KJV: the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches [ of ] ivory , [ brought ]

6.english_reference: [ brought ] out of the isles of Chittim .

traditions.WLC: מֵ אִיֵּ֖י כתים
traditions.LXX: οἴκους ἀλσώδεις ἀπὸ νήσων τῶν Χεττείν .
traditions.VUL: et prætoríola de ínsulis Itáliæ .
traditions.KJV: out of the isles of Chittim .

7.english_reference: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail ;

traditions.WLC: שֵׁשׁ בְּ רִקְמָ֤ה מִ מִּצְרַ֨יִם֙ הָיָ֣ה מִפְרָשֵׂ֔ ךְ לִ הְי֥וֹת לָ֖ ךְ לְ נֵ֑ס
traditions.LXX: βύσσος μετὰ ποικιλίας ἐξ Αἰγύπτου ἐγένετό σοι στρωμνή , τοῦ περιθεῖναί σοι δόξαν
traditions.VUL: Byssus vária de Ægýpto texta est tibi in velum ut ponerétur in malo :
traditions.KJV: Fine linen with broidered work from Egypt was that which thou spreadest forth to be thy sail ;

7.english_reference: blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee .

traditions.WLC: תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְ אַרְגָּמָ֛ן מֵ אִיֵּ֥י אֱלִישָׁ֖ה הָיָ֥ה מְכַסֵּֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ περιβαλεῖν σε ὑάκινθον καὶ πορφύραν ἐκ τῶν νήσων Ἐλεισαί , καὶ ἐγένετο περιβόλαιά σου .
traditions.VUL: hyacínthus , et púrpura de ínsulis Elísa facta sunt operiméntum tuum .
traditions.KJV: blue and purple from the isles of Elishah was that which covered thee .

8.english_reference: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners :

traditions.WLC: יֹשְׁבֵ֤י צִידוֹן֙ וְ אַרְוַ֔ד הָי֥וּ שָׁטִ֖ים לָ֑ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντές σου οἱ κατοικοῦντες Σειδῶνα καὶ Ἀράδιοι ἐγένοντο κωπηλάται σου ·
traditions.VUL: Habitatóres Sidónis et Arádii fuérunt rémiges tui :
traditions.KJV: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners :

8.english_reference: thy wise [ men ] , O Tyrus , [ that ] were in thee , were thy pilots .

traditions.WLC: חֲכָמַ֤יִ ךְ צוֹר֙ הָ֣יוּ בָ֔ ךְ הֵ֖מָּה חֹבְלָֽיִ ךְ
traditions.LXX: οἱ σοφοί σου , Σόρ , οἳ ἦσαν ἐν σοί , οὗτοι κυβερνῆταί σου ·
traditions.VUL: sapiéntes tui , Tyre , facti sunt gubernatóres tui .
traditions.KJV: thy wise [ men ] , O Tyrus , [ that ] were in thee , were thy pilots .

9.english_reference: The ancients of Gebal and the wise [ men ] thereof were in thee thy calkers :

traditions.WLC: זִקְנֵ֨י גְבַ֤ל וַ חֲכָמֶ֨י הָ֙ הָ֣יוּ בָ֔ ךְ מַחֲזִיקֵ֖י בִּדְקֵ֑ ךְ
traditions.LXX: οἱ πρεσβύτεροι Βυβλίων καὶ οἱ σοφοὶ αὐτῶν ἦσαν ἐν σοί , οὗτοι ἐνίσχυον τὴν βουλήν σου ·
traditions.VUL: Senes Gíblii et prudéntes eius habuérunt nautas ad ministérium váriæ supelléctilis tuæ :
traditions.KJV: The ancients of Gebal and the wise [ men ] thereof were in thee thy calkers :

9.english_reference: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise .

traditions.WLC: כָּל אֳנִיּ֨וֹת הַ יָּ֤ם וּ מַלָּֽחֵי הֶם֙ הָ֣יוּ בָ֔ ךְ לַ עֲרֹ֖ב מַעֲרָבֵֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ πάντα τὰ πλοῖα τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ οἱ κωπηλάται αὐτῶν ἐγένοντό σοι ἐπὶ δυσμὰς δυσμῶν .
traditions.VUL: omnes naves maris , et nautæ eárum fuérunt in pópulo negotiatiónis tuæ .
traditions.KJV: all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise .

10.english_reference: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army , thy men of war :

traditions.LXX: Πέρσαι καὶ Λυδοὶ καὶ Λίβυες ἦσαν ἐν τῇ δυνάμει σου , ἄνδρες πολεμισταί σου
traditions.VUL: Persæ , et Lýdii , et Líbyes erant in exércitu tuo viri bellatóres tui :
traditions.KJV: They of Persia and of Lud and of Phut were in thine army , thy men of war :

10.english_reference: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee ;

traditions.WLC: מָגֵ֤ן וְ כוֹבַע֙ תִּלּוּ בָ֔ ךְ
traditions.LXX: πέλτας καὶ περικεφαλαίας ἐκρέμασαν ἐν σοί ,
traditions.VUL: clýpeum , et gáleam suspendérunt in te
traditions.KJV: they hanged the shield and helmet in thee ;

traditions.WLC: הֵ֖מָּה נָתְנ֥וּ הֲדָרֵֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: οὗτοι ἔδωκαν τὴν δόξαν σου .
traditions.VUL: pro ornátu tuo .
traditions.KJV: they set forth thy comeliness .

11.english_reference: The men of Arvad with thine army [ were ] upon thy walls round about

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֧י אַרְוַ֣ד וְ חֵילֵ֗ךְ עַל חוֹמוֹתַ֨יִ ךְ֙ סָבִ֔יב
traditions.LXX: υἱοὶ Ἀραδίων καὶ ἡ δύναμίς σου ἐπὶ τῶν τειχέων σου ·
traditions.VUL: Fílii Arádii cum exércitu tuo erant super muros tuos in circúitu :
traditions.KJV: The men of Arvad with thine army [ were ] upon thy walls round about ,

11.english_reference: and the Gammadims were in thy towers

traditions.WLC: וְ גַ֨מָּדִ֔ים בְּ מִגְדְּלוֹתַ֖יִ ךְ הָי֑וּ
traditions.LXX: φύλακες ἐν τοῖς πύργοις σου ἦσαν ,
traditions.VUL: sed et Pigmǽi , qui erant in túrribus tuis ,
traditions.KJV: and the Gammadims were in thy towers :

11.english_reference: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about

traditions.WLC: שִׁלְטֵי הֶ֞ם תִּלּ֤וּ עַל חוֹמוֹתַ֨יִ ךְ֙ סָבִ֔יב
traditions.LXX: τὰς φαρέτρας αὐτῶν ἐκρέμασαν ἐπὶ τῶν ὅρμων σου κύκλῳ ·
traditions.VUL: pháretras suas suspendérunt in muris tuis per gyrum :
traditions.KJV: they hanged their shields upon thy walls round about ;

11.english_reference: they have made thy beauty perfect

traditions.WLC: הֵ֖מָּה כָּלְל֥וּ יָפְיֵֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: οὗτοι ἐτελείωσάν σου τὸ κάλλος .
traditions.VUL: ipsi complevérunt pulchritúdinem tuam .
traditions.KJV: they have made thy beauty perfect .

12.english_reference: Tarshish [ was ] thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all [ kind of ] riches

traditions.WLC: תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ סֹחַרְתֵּ֖ ךְ מֵ רֹ֣ב כָּל ה֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: Καρχηδόνιοι ἔμποροί σου ἀπὸ πλήθους πάσης ἰσχύος σου ,
traditions.VUL: Carthaginénses negotiatóres tui , a multitúdine cunctárum divitiárum ,
traditions.KJV: Tarshish [ was ] thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all [ kind of ] riches ;

12.english_reference: with silver , iron , tin , and lead , they traded in thy fairs

traditions.WLC: בְּ כֶ֤סֶף בַּרְזֶל֙ בְּדִ֣יל וְ עוֹפֶ֔רֶת נָתְנ֖וּ עִזְבוֹנָֽיִ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον καὶ σίδηρον καὶ κασσίτερον καὶ μόλυβον ἔδωκαν τὴν ἀγοράν σου .
traditions.VUL: argénto , ferro , stanno , plumbóque replevérunt núndinas tuas .
traditions.KJV: with silver , iron , tin , and lead , they traded in thy fairs .

13.english_reference: Javan , Tubal , and Meshech , they [ were ] thy merchants

traditions.WLC: יָוָ֤ן תֻּבַל֙ וָ מֶ֔שֶׁךְ הֵ֖מָּה רֹֽכְלָ֑יִ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἡ Ἑλλάς , καὶ ἡ σύμπασα , καὶ τὰ παρατείνοντα , οὗτοι ἐνεπορεύοντό σοι
traditions.VUL: Grǽcia , Thubal , et Mosoch , ipsi institóres tui :
traditions.KJV: Javan , Tubal , and Meshech , they [ were ] thy merchants :

13.english_reference: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market

traditions.WLC: בְּ נֶ֤פֶשׁ אָדָם֙ וּ כְלֵ֣י נְחֹ֔שֶׁת נָתְנ֖וּ מַעֲרָבֵֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐν ψυχαῖς ἀνθρώπων , καὶ σκεύη χαλκᾶ ἔδωκαν τὴν ἐμπορίαν σου ·
traditions.VUL: mancípia , et vasa ǽrea advexérunt pópulo tuo .
traditions.KJV: they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market .

14.english_reference: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules

traditions.WLC: מִ בֵּ֖ית תּוֹגַרְמָ֑ה סוּסִ֤ים וּ פָֽרָשִׁים֙ וּ פְרָדִ֔ים נָתְנ֖וּ עִזְבוֹנָֽיִ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐξ οἴκου Θαιγραμὰ ἵπποι καὶ ἱππεῖς ἔδωκαν ἀγοράν σου .
traditions.VUL: De domo Thogórma , equos , et équites , et mulos adduxérunt ad forum tuum .
traditions.KJV: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules .

15.english_reference: The men of Dedan [ were ] thy merchants

traditions.WLC: בְּנֵ֤י דְדָן֙ רֹֽכְלַ֔יִ ךְ
traditions.LXX: υἱοὶ Ῥοδίων ἔμποροι ,
traditions.VUL: Fílii Dedan negotiatóres tui :
traditions.KJV: The men of Dedan [ were ] thy merchants ;

15.english_reference: many isles [ were ] the merchandise of thine hand

traditions.WLC: אִיִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים סְחֹרַ֣ת יָדֵ֑ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ νήσων ἐπλήθυναν τὴν ἐμπορίαν σου
traditions.VUL: ínsulæ multæ , negotiátio manus tuæ :
traditions.KJV: many isles [ were ] the merchandise of thine hand :

15.english_reference: they brought thee [ for ] a present horns of ivory and ebony

traditions.WLC: קַרְנ֥וֹת שֵׁן֙ ו הובנים הֵשִׁ֖יבוּ אֶשְׁכָּרֵֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ὀδόντας ἐλεφαντίνους , καὶ τοῖς εἰσαγομένοις ἀντεδίδους τοὺς μισθούς σου ·
traditions.VUL: dentes ebúrneos , et hebéninos commutavérunt in prétio tuo .
traditions.KJV: they brought thee [ for ] a present horns of ivory and ebony .

16.english_reference: Syria [ was ] thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making

traditions.WLC: אֲרָ֥ם סֹחַרְתֵּ֖ ךְ מֵ רֹ֣ב מַעֲשָׂ֑יִ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἀνθρώπους ἐμπορίαν σου ἀπὸ πλήθους τοῦ συμμίκτου σου ,
traditions.VUL: Syrus negotiátor tuus propter multitúdinem óperum tuórum :
traditions.KJV: Syria [ was ] thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making :

16.english_reference: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds , purple , and broidered work , and fine linen , and coral , and agate

traditions.WLC: בְּ֠ נֹפֶךְ אַרְגָּמָ֨ן וְ רִקְמָ֤ה וּ בוּץ֙ וְ רָאמֹ֣ת וְ כַדְכֹּ֔ד נָתְנ֖וּ בְּ עִזְבוֹנָֽיִ ךְ
traditions.LXX: στακτὴν καὶ ποικίλματα ἐκ Θαρσείς · καὶ Λαμὼθ καὶ Χορχὸρ ἔδωκαν τὴν ἀγοράν σου .
traditions.VUL: gemmam , et púrpuram , et scutuláta , et byssum , et séricum , et chodchod proposuérunt in mercátu tuo .
traditions.KJV: they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds , purple , and broidered work , and fine linen , and coral , and agate .

17.english_reference: Judah , and the land of Israel , they [ were ] thy merchants

traditions.WLC: יְהוּדָה֙ וְ אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֵ֖מָּה רֹכְלָ֑יִ ךְ
traditions.LXX: Ἰούδας καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ , οὗτοι ἔμποροί σου
traditions.VUL: Iuda et terra Israel ipsi institóres tui
traditions.KJV: Judah , and the land of Israel , they [ were ] thy merchants :

traditions.WLC: בְּ חִטֵּ֣י מִ֠נִּית וּ פַנַּ֨ג וּ דְבַ֤שׁ וָ שֶׁ֨מֶן֙ וָ צֹ֔רִי נָתְנ֖וּ מַעֲרָבֵֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐν σίτου πράσει καὶ μύρων καὶ κασίᾳ , καὶ πρῶτον μέλι καὶ ἔλαιον καὶ ῥητίνην ἔδωκαν εἰς τὸν σύμμικτόν σου .

traditions.KJV: they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith , and Pannag , and honey , and oil , and balm .

18.english_reference: Damascus [ was ] thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making , for the multitude of all riches

traditions.WLC: דַּמֶּ֧שֶׂק סֹחַרְתֵּ֛ ךְ בְּ רֹ֥ב מַעֲשַׂ֖יִ ךְ מֵ רֹ֣ב כָּל ה֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: Δαμασκὸς ἔμπορός σου ἐκ πλήθους πάσης δυνάμεώς σου ·
